<title
    level="1"
    right="Familiar Ability "
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Elemental](/Familiars.aspx?ID=112) <actions string="" />
</title>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 212

**Ability Type** Familiar

</column>

Your familiar has the [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=57) trait instead of the [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=9) trait. Choose [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165), or [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508). Your familiar gains that trait. The familiar is immune to [bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145), and the element matching its trait. Your familiar must have the resistance familiar ability to select this.
